description: Delete a group from your GrowSurf program. Its members move to Default, and its Campaign Rewards are removed from the program. Rewards already earned keep their amounts and can still be sent. Returns { id, success, movedToDefault }. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program id for this call: the `id` returned by `growsurf_list_campaigns`, not the program name or a share URL. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_delete_campaign_group

movedToDefault.description: The number of members moved to Default.

title: Delete Campaign Group
